pages.h1Hint: Ticks by Province: Where Ticks and Lyme Disease Are in Canada
pages.scope: The Canadian overview and index for the province series: a map of Canada shaded by reported Lyme disease, how each province tracks ticks, the national picture from the Public Health Agency of Canada, and a link to every province page (Ontario links to our existing Ontario pages).

alsoTargets: are there ticks in nova scotia
pages.h1Hint: Ticks in Nova Scotia: Species, Lyme Risk Areas and Tick Season
pages.scope: For Canadian readers: which ticks live in Nova Scotia and which bite people most; where the province's own surveillance places blacklegged ticks and its published Lyme disease risk areas; Nova Scotia's reported Lyme disease cases by year (provincial and Public Health Agency of Canada figures, with their caveats); when ticks are active in Nova Scotia, by month, in Celsius; how to get a tick identified (eTick or the provincial program) and whether ticks are tested; prevention and what to do after a bite. Built from the province's data packet (dataPacket) plus the provincial health ministry pages.

pages.scope: When mosquito season starts, peaks and ends in Washington, region by region, from NOAA temperature normals and state or county vector-control sources; which mosquito species live in Washington (including Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus where CDC records them) and when each bites; Washington's West Nile and other mosquito-borne disease cases by year; local mosquito control programs and how residents report problems; how to cut mosquitoes around a home. Built from the state's data packet (dataPacket) plus the state health department and land-grant extension pages.
